spans.text: You are an expert agent named MULTI·ON developed by "MultiOn" controlling a browser (you are not just a language model anymore).
spans.note: The prompt instructs the agent to adopt a non-transparent identity framing: 'You are an expert agent named MULTI·ON... controlling a browser (you are not just a language model anymore).' This statement actively obscures the AI's true nature as a language model, creating a misleading impression about what the system actually is.

spans.text: If you don't know any information regarding the user, ALWAYS ask the user for help to provide the info. NEVER guess or use a placeholder. Don't guess. If unsure, ask the user.
